title: UNDERBODY-LOCK PILLAR PANEL & REAR SPLASH SHIELD
summary: Rear underbody behind the doors: the body lock pillar panels (LH/RH) and the rear quarter splash shields (inner rear fender / wheelhouse splash panels, LH/RH) are bonded fiberglass (bonds A, G, K). On coupes a tapping plate for the storage tray (behind-seat storage compartment tray screws) is riveted behind the shield, using the plate as a drilling template.

parts.name: SHIELD-REAR QUARTER SPLASH
parts.name_expanded: Shield – rear quarter splash (inner rear wheelhouse panel, LH/RH)

parts.name: PLATE-TAPPING STORAGE TRAY
parts.name_expanded: Plate – tapping, storage tray (screw plate for the rear storage tray)

fastening.to: rear quarter splash shield [1] area, behind the storage tray
fastening.note: View A: rivets [3] hold tapping plate [4] through .218/.192 dia holes, (2) places each side; 7/32 (+0/-1/64) dia holes, (4) places each side, drilled using [4] as template, for the storage tray screws. Dimensions 2.76, 1.05, .32 from datum (20).

Splash shield [1] and lock pillar panel [2]: fiberglass panels shown bonded (BOND A and G at the shield, BOND K at the lock pillar panel); no mechanical fasteners, so no fastening entry.
